build_model_and_tokenizer: build a DINOTxt model with training transforms and tokenizer for vision-language training
build_model_for_eval: build a DINOTxt model loaded with pretrained weights and eval transforms for inference
load_backbone_checkpoint: load pretrained weights from a PyTorch or DCP checkpoint into a model backbone
compile_parallelize_and_init: wrap a DINOTxt model in FSDP or DDP, compile it, and initialize weights
rename_register_token: rename register_tokens to storage_tokens in a checkpoint state dict for DINOv2 compatibility
